Let <MATH_0001> be a scheme and let <MATH_0002> be a quasi-coherent
<MATH_0003>-algebra. An <MATH_0004>-module is
quasi-coherent as an <MATH_0005>-module if and only if
it is quasi-coherent as an <MATH_0006>-module.

Let <MATH_0001> be an <MATH_0002>-module.
If <MATH_0003> is quasi-coherent as an <MATH_0004>-module, then
for every <MATH_0005> there exists an open neighbourhood <MATH_0006> of <MATH_0007>
and an exact sequence
<MATH_0008>
of <MATH_0009>-modules.

Hence <MATH_0011> is quasi-coherent as the cokernel of a morphism
of quasi-coherent <MATH_0012>-modules on a scheme. It follows
